fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use Alibaba Cloud DNS. Valid values: true or false. Default value: true.

If the value is true, you do not need to provide the OrderActivateParam.N.Dns1 and OrderActivateParam.N.Dns2 parameters. Otherwise, any provided OrderActivateParam.N.Dns1 and OrderActivateParam.N.Dns2 parameters will not take effect.  
If the value is false, you must also provide the OrderActivateParam.N.Dns1 and OrderActivateParam.N.Dns2 parameters

fields.help_en:
The domain name registrant profile ID. A registrant profile includes information such as the registrant name, contact, telephone number, and mailbox. You can register a domain name only by using a domain name registrant profile ID that has passed identity verification. If you have already created a domain name registrant profile, you can query the profile ID by invoking the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/67701.html API.

After this parameter is provided, you do not need to provide the following parameters: OrderActivateParam.N.RegistrantType, OrderActivateParam.N.ZhRegistrantOrganization, OrderActivateParam.N.ZhRegistrantName, OrderActivateParam.N.ZhProvince, OrderActivateParam.N.ZhCity, OrderActivateParam.N.ZhAddress, OrderActivateParam.N.RegistrantOrganization, OrderActivateParam.N.RegistrantName, OrderActivateParam.N.Province, OrderActivateParam.N.City, OrderActivateParam.N.Address, OrderActivateParam.N.PostalCode, OrderActivateParam.N.Country, OrderActivateParam.N.TelArea, OrderActivateParam.N.Telephone, OrderActivateParam.N.TelExt, and OrderActivateParam.N.Email
fields.help_zh:
域名信息模板编号（信息模板包含域名持有者名称、域名联系人、电话、邮箱等信息），仅能使用已实名认证的域名信息模板编号进行域名注册。如果您已经创建了域名注册信息模板，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/67701.html 接口查询域名信息模板编号。

传入本参数后，无需再传入OrderActivateParam.N.RegistrantType、OrderActivateParam.N.ZhRegistrantOrganization、OrderActivateParam.N.ZhRegistrantName、OrderActivateParam.N.ZhProvince、OrderActivateParam.N.ZhCity、OrderActivateParam.N.ZhAddress、OrderActivateParam.N.RegistrantOrganization、OrderActivateParam.N.RegistrantName、OrderActivateParam.N.Province、OrderActivateParam.N.City、OrderActivateParam.N.Address、OrderActivateParam.N.PostalCode、OrderActivateParam.N.Country、OrderActivateParam.N.TelArea、OrderActivateParam.N.Telephone、OrderActivateParam.N.TelExt和OrderActivateParam.N.Email参数
